content.title: Tracker Cast: Who’s Who In The Hit Drama
content.text: Since premiering in 2024, Tracker has become one of TV’s most-watched dramas. One of the main reasons for its success? Justin Hartley, who anchors the CBS Original drama as Colter Shaw, a lone survivalist and skilled tracker with a knack for finding missing people. But while Colter’s a loner, Hartley belongs to a cast – an ensemble of actors whose characters support Colter, and challenge him. Here’s your guide to the cast of Tracker, plus info on the characters they play. SPOILER ALERT: Key plot points from the first two seasons of Tracker will be discussed. What is Tracker about? Tracker follows Colter Shaw, a rewardist who finds missing people (or resolves the mysteries of what happened to them). Each episode presents Colter with a new client, and a new mission. Along the way, Colter confronts his family’s dark history, including his father’s unsolved murder. Colter eventually learns the truth about this death – and his mother’s role in it – setting up Tracker to deliver even more drama. CBS Who plays Colter Shaw in Tracker? Justin Hartley plays Colter Shaw in Tracker. He pulls double duty on the show as an executive producer. Other top credits: This Is Us, Smallville, The Young and the Restless About the character: Colter, who makes his living as a reward seeker, balances grit with vulnerability while navigating dangerous cases. CBS Who stars in Tracker Season 3? Tracker Season 3 stars Justin Hartley as Colter Shaw. Additionally, Fiona Rene returns to the reg cast as Reenie Greene. Guest star Chris Lee reprises his role of Randy, while Jensen Ackles is back as a special guest star in the role of Russell, Colter’s brother. Tracker Season 2 cast and characters Tracker Season 2 follows Colter as he takes on new cases, all the while being pulled deeper into the mystery of his family’s past. His search for the missing leads him to uncover a trafficking ring, hidden corruption, and long-buried secrets about his father’s death. Here’s a rundown of the cast and characters who come into play in Tracker Season 2. Who plays Velma Bruin on Tracker Season 2? Abby McEnany plays Velma Bruin on Tracker Season 2. Other top credits: Work in Progress, And Just Like That … About the character: Velma steps up into a larger role after her wife Teddi (Robin Weigert) leaves town to care for her mother. Velma moves operations into Reenie’s law office, becoming Colter’s main handler. Who plays Bobby Exley on Tracker Season 2? Eric Graise plays Bobby Exley on Tracker Season 2. Other top credits: The Tomorrow War, Teenage Bounty Hunters About the character: In Season 2, Bobby is back to his hacking, surveillance, and digital investigations … until, that is, he takes a leave of absence in the episode “Nightingale.” (He returns later in the season.) Who plays Randy on Tracker Season 2? Chris Lee plays Randy on Tracker Season 2. Other top credits: The Chi, Legacies About the character: When Bobby takes a leave of absence, his cousin Randy takes over his job. Randy proves more than capable of keeping Colter’s operations running. Who plays Reenie Greene on Tracker Season 2? Fiona Rene plays Reenie Greene on Tracker Season 2. Other top credits: The Lincoln Lawyer, I Know What You Did Last Summer About the character: Season 2 sees Reenie launching her own law firm. Her professional growth is paralleled by her personal journey, as she navigates her sometimes confusing feelings for Colter. She also takes on a very controversial client, Leo Sharf (Pet Vahdat), who constantly encourages her to undertake morally questionable tasks like digging up dirt on his business partner. Tracker Season 1 cast and characters In Tracker Season 1, Colter’s pursuits range from finding a kidnapped racehorse to uncovering the truth behind a missing MMA fighter. Even as he tracks down answers to these cases, Colter is haunted by his own family secrets. Read on for a look at the cast and characters of Tracker Season 1. Who plays Teddi Bruin on Tracker Season 1? Robin Weigert plays Teddie Bruin on Tracker Season 1. Other top credits: Deadwood, Smile About the character: Teddi manages the operations behind Colter’s cases. She sources assignments, handles logistics, and provides support from her home base in Northern Florida. Teddi’s expertise in organizing and coordinating plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of Shaw’s missions. Who plays Velma Bruin on Tracker Season 1? Abby McEnany plays Velma Bruin on Tracker Season 1. About the character: Velma works alongside her wife, Teddi, serving as one of Colter’s handlers. Her job is to make sure Colter has the necessary resources to undertake his missions. Who plays Bobby Exley on Tracker Season 1? Eric Graise plays Bobby Exley on Tracker Season 1. About the character: Bobby serves as Colter’s tech support, providing crucial intel and hacking assistance from his base in Chicago. Who plays Reenie Greene on Tracker Season 1? Fiona Rene plays Reenie Greene on Tracker Season 1. About the character: Reenie is the attorney on Colter’s team. She is pivotal in navigating the legal complexities that arise during Colter’s missions. A past romantic history between Reenie and Colter is hinted at. Tracker reoccurring + guest stars Colter’s mysterious family adds layers to his story, and intriguing characters from it appear throughout the series to complicate matters. These visitors keep his personal world as unpredictable as his cases. CBS Who plays Russell Shaw on Tracker? Jensen Ackles plays Russell Shaw on Tracker. Other top credits: Supernatural, My Bloody Valentine About the character: Russell is Colter’s estranged older brother, a former soldier turned private security contractor. The siblings’ strained relationship is marked by unresolved family tensions, including the mysterious death of their father, Ashton Shaw (Lee Tergesen). Who plays Pet Vahdat as Leonard Sharf? Pet Vahdat plays the role of Leonard Sharf in Tracker. Other top credits: Poker Face, The Old Man About the character: Leonard hires Reenie to gather leverage against a founding partner of his company; he insists on discretion and a lack of paper trail. Along the way, there are hints that Leonard may be hiding secrets that could connect to Colter’s family history. When and where can you watch Tracker? You can watch all episodes of Tracker on Paramount+. Seasons 1 and 2 are available to binge-watch now. Tracker Season 3 premiered Oct. 19, 2025. See below for tune-in details on how to watch new episodes: Tracker Season 3 Premiere date: Oct. 19, 2025 New episodes air: Sundays Time: 8-9 PM ET/PT Channel: CBS Streaming: Paramount+* * New episodes of Tracker can be streamed live as they air on CBS with Paramount+ via the Paramount+ Premium plan, and/or they can be watched on demand, starting the day after they air, with Paramount+ (any plan).
